title: Vijnana Harate, Anantha Vidyaniketan — IASc and RRI Visit
teaser: Vijnana Harate for 60 ninth-grade students of Anantha Vidyaniketan: talk by Prof. Seetha, hands-on activities by Agastya, and a curated visit to the Raman Museum and RRI Archives Gallery.
homepageMatter: On 22 July 2025, sixty 9th-grade students of Anantha Vidyaniketan visited IASc, Bengaluru, for a Vijnana Harate session. Prof. Seetha gave the main talk, the Agastya team led hands-on activities, and students explored the Raman Museum and RRI Archives Gallery.
